translation.name: Dillꞌ wen dillꞌ   Kob C̱he   Jesucrístonaꞌ

book.name: Apocalipsis
book.title: Jesucrístona' bliile' Juanna' c̱he diika' zi' gak

content: Yeḻ' zak'zi'ka' gall daa yoll ḻoo kopka'
Na' benid' wṉe to beṉ' zillj inlleb ḻoo yoodo'na', chi'e anjlka' gall: ―Ḻi shaj na' ḻi lljalatj lo yell-liona' yeḻ' zak'zi' c̱he Chioza' diika' yoll ḻoo kopka' gall.

Na' wyaj anjl necha', jalatje' yeḻ' zak'zi' daa yoll ḻoo kop c̱he'na' lo yell-liona' na' yog'ḻoḻ beṉ'ka' yoo seṉ c̱he bayix̱aa na' be'la'ogake' lwaa lsak'ba' byaljgake' we' dii wyoll guull' na' wyey wlagake'.
Na' anjl, beṉ' wchopina', jalatje' yeḻ' zak'zi' daa yoll ḻoo kop c̱he'na' lo nisdo'na', na' nisdo'na' biyakan ka xc̱hen beṉ' witi yesya, na' wit yog'ḻoḻ dii de yeḻ' mban c̱heyin ḻoo nisdo'na'.
Na' anjl, beṉ' wyoṉina', jalatje' yeḻ' zak'zi' daa yoll ḻoo kop c̱he'na' ḻoo yaoka' na' yog' ga chal nis, na' biyakgakan chen.

Na' benid' wṉe anjla' blalj yeḻ' zak'zi'na' lo nisa', wne': ―Chios, lin' nako' dowalj beṉ' ḻi beṉ' shao'. Lin' zo' ṉaa, na' li'kzan zo' ka wxe wzil yell-lioni. Lin' chono' daa nak shḻicha daa ba bc̱hoglo' c̱he beṉ'ki kon ka chiyaḻ' gak.
Ḻa' ḻegake' blaljgake' xc̱hen beṉ'ka' nak lall' no' na' beṉ'ka' wdix̱jee daa gollo' ḻegake', na' ba be'gako'ne' chenna' yeejgake', ka chidoḻ'kzə gak c̱hegake'n.

Na' ḻekzka' benid' wna beena' ze kwit daa nak ka gana' chzeygake' diika' chjwa'gake' lao Chioza', ne': ―Kan' nakan Chios, beṉ' nak X̱annto', beṉ' yeḻ' wak choo yeḻ' wak xen, li' ba beno' yeḻ' josc̱his kon ka chiyaḻ' gakan.
Na' anjl, beṉ' wdapina', jalatje' yeḻ' zak'zi' daa yoll ḻoo kop c̱he'na' lo wbilldo'na', na' bzeyan beṉ' yell-liona'.
Na' yog'ḻoḻgake' wyeygake' nall inlleb. Per bi biyaj bilengakile' lao Chioza', ni bi be'la'ogake'ne', san wṉelgake' zban c̱he' daa bi'e latj chak yeḻ' zak'zi'ka'.

Na' anjl, beṉ' gayi'na', jalatje' yeḻ' zak'zi' daa yoll ḻoo kop c̱he'na' gana' llia bayix̱aa chṉabia'b, bana' bchej ḻoo nisdo'na', na' gok shgasj shc̱hoḻ doxen gana' chṉabia'b. Na' beṉ' yell-lioka' non ḻeb txen wdaoyaa ḻolleeka' daa ḻe wyey wlagake'.
Na' wṉelgake' zban c̱he Chioza', beena' zoa yabana', daa chey chlagake' ni c̱he we'ka' lliagake', na' bi biyaj bilengakile' dii mala' chongake'.
Na' anjl, beṉ' wxopina', jalatje' yeḻ' zak'zi' daa yoll ḻoo kop c̱he'na' ḻoo yao xenna' le Éufrates, na' biyeej yao xenna' kwenc̱he gok wde beṉ' wṉabia'ka' za' gana' chla'lə wbilla'.

Na' ble'id' shoṉ dii x̱iw' dii nak ka bḻoll. Ton bchej ḻoo cho'a bayix̱' xṉana', na' ston bchej lo cho'a bayix̱aa bana' be'la'o beṉ' yell-liona', na' ston bchej ḻoo cho'a bana' chziye' beṉ', cho'eb dill' daa che' bayix̱aa sto ḻeb.

Na' dii x̱iw'ki chongakan yeḻ' wak. Na' bchejgakan jatopgakan beṉ' wṉabia'ka' lle' doxen yell-lioni kwenc̱he yiyakgake' toz tiḻ-lengake' Chioza', beena' zeelo nap yeḻ' wak choo yeḻ' wak xen, kat' illin lla choo lla xen c̱he'na'.
“Ḻi se wṉeyi, nad' zizaa tokonganzi, ka chon to beṉ' wban aga no chsi'nile' kat' chjḻane'. Chakomba beena' ze wṉeyi na' nakw xe'na' kwenc̱he bi te gaḻ'yid gaḻ'bel'ze' na' si'e yeḻ' zto'.”
Na' dii x̱iw'ka' btopgakan beṉ' wṉabia'ka' latja' le Armagedón de dill' hebreo.
Na' anjl, beṉ' gállina', blatje' yeḻ' zak'zi' daa yoll ḻoo kop c̱he'na' lo llazə. Na' ḻoo yoodo'na' zoa yabana', gana' llia Chioza' chṉabi'e, wṉie' zillj, wne': ―Ba gok daa chiyaḻ' gak.
Na'ch wyep yes, na' gok sshag, na' goshj wtin, na' bṉib yell-liona' ni c̱he to bedxo' xen inlleb dii nakch zibia' ka yog' bedxo'ka' ba gok shlak wzoa beṉ' lo yell-lioni.

Na' yell daa ḻe zeyi c̱heyin gokan shoṉ ḻaalə, na' yellka' lle' yell-lioni wlliayi'gakan. Na' ngoo yic̱hj Chioza' wsak'zi'e Babilóniana', yella' ḻe zeyi c̱heyin, kwenc̱he beṉ'ka' lle' na' yen ile'gakile' yeḻ' zak'zi' xen c̱he'na' daa ḻe bshaagake' ḻe'.
Na' yog' yell-liodo'ka' llia lo nisdo'na' na' no yaaka' binitlogakan.
Na' xan yabana' bxop yaj yaba dii yeḻ inlleb na' ziigakan wdeli c̱hoa kil. Na' beṉ' yell-lioka' wṉelgake' zban c̱he Chioza' ni c̱he yaj yabana' daa gokan to yeḻ' zak'zi' xen inlleb.
